additional_info.subject: ID0372084-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / RD 170003002] OCPP Toggles & CMS Damaged CRM:00643000842
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Luca,﻿
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Shrey
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / RD 170003002
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
6Kb5jC
Problem Description
: OCPP Toggles & CMS Damaged
Troubleshooting
:
We have analyzed the logs and found that the OCPP disconnection occurs every 30 seconds. I checked the WebSocketPingInterval, which is set to 30 seconds, and the HeartBeatInterval, which is set to 60 seconds. However, when we checked the OCPP configuration, the OCPP URL is showing as "Mindcharge." Could you please confirm the backend provider name? When we checked with this name, there was no successful backend integration found.
Additionally, there is another ticket related to the Cable Management System for this charger. I have merged both tickets into one. For this issue, you will need to order the spare parts and make the necessary changes.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0372084
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey Sharma

additional_info.subject: RE: R: ID0372084-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / RD 170003002] OCPP Toggles & CMS Damaged CRM:00643000842
additional_info.body:
Hi Luca,
I hope this email finds you well!
Regarding the OCPP issue, yesterday we made some changes to the router to improve network strength. We set the network operator to manual and selected ILIAD, and we also disabled the WAN failover feature. The connection seemed stable for about 3 hours last night, but the OCPP is still toggling between online and offline.
Could you please discuss with the backend team and confirm the following details:
OCPP Charge Point ID
OCPP URL
APN settings
Authentication mode
Username and password, if required
There might be a server-side issue, as the router configuration doesn't appear to have any issues. If the necessary information you provided above is confirmed, we will monitor the situation. If the issue persists, we recommend conducting backend integration testing again, and we will forward it to the Backend Integration Team afterwards.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey
